notes: NovaShell now verifies two-controller N64 versus readiness and adds a read-only cleanup and recovery coach with completed-backup status.
changes: N64 versus launch now confirms Chrome sees two distinct controllers before starting and clearly shows whether player two is ready.
Storage details now include a read-only cleanup and recovery coach for stale Downloads, recoverable Trash, and the last completed selective backup.
Backup completion state is stored only in ignored local data and never includes credentials or file contents.
Hosted NovaShell now includes Retro/Cobalt, touch/controller navigation, explicit IndexedDB game selection, Orbit, Notes, Kanban, Weather, Browse, Relay guidance, and browser backup.
Public docs and the parity matrix now identify exactly which hosted features work and which still require local NovaShell.
Show large files, open my music folder, and back up game saves now resolve to explicit NovaShell routes instead of falling through as unknown text.
Sensitive-looking intents show a controller-compatible preview stating what data is read and confirming that no file or backup changes happen automatically.
The import screen now has one transaction owner and sends the required catalog key and source path after a local ROM copy.
Existing owned games update their private card without overwriting existing artwork, and interrupted metadata appears in the review queue rather than vanishing.
Manage local games now has All, Needs details, and Multiplayer queues plus search, location identity, a consistent editor window, and owner-art replacement with ignored local backups.
Weather Station now uses one self-contained modular runtime instead of layered legacy scripts and styles.
Forecast URLs can specify a place, public captures skip private local defaults, and the last successful report remains usable when weather sources are offline.
Xbox pads are sorted by physical browser index and assigned independently to player one through player four, including controllers exposed after the emulator starts.
N64 fighter detection now includes Mortal Kombat, Killer Instinct, ClayFighter, Fighter's Destiny, Mace, War Gods, Dark Rift, and other local-versus titles.
The full EmulatorJS map now includes both analog sticks, triggers, D-pad, face buttons, shoulders, and stick clicks.
N64 games marked multiplayer—and known local-versus classics—show a direct two-player launch in their game sheet.
Rail Finder now has a private-key CTA departure and arrival board, and Reset Station has expanded breathing and recovery routines.
NovaShell World now uses a low-resolution multi-room pixel building with real local stations.
